issues.description: Macro FIX_LEN (which controls the typedef size of fix_t) is inconsistent between the template example program and the template tests. In template/example_program/src/math_fix.h FIX_LEN is defined as 8 (so fix_t is a 64-bit signed type), while in template/tests/src/math_fix.h FIX_LEN is defined as 4 (so fix_t is a 32-bit signed type). This mismatch changes the size and ABI of fix_t across components (headers, tests, and assembly/C linkage) and will cause compilation, linking, or subtle runtime/data-corruption problems when the tests and example program are built/linked together. The solution repository uses FIX_LEN = 8 in its files (tests and example_program), showing the intended value is 8.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the template's example_program and tests. The simplest fix is to change template/tests/src/math_fix.h to define FIX_LEN 8 (to match example_program and the solution). After changing the macro, verify typedefs for fix_t/fixu_t in both files resolve to the same width and rebuild tests and example_program. Optionally add a short note in the repository README or problem statement indicating the required FIX_LEN value (and where to change it) so students understand the expected fixed-point width.
